Broad, non-specific Indian freedom struggle series (e.g., generic 'Part 1' independence stories without a specific tragedy/hero hook)
title_patterns: Specific Year + Mundane Reality Shock Value: '[Year] की [Season] में लोग [Basic Task] कैसे करते थे?' or '[Year] में [Amount] रुपये में क्या आता था?'
Tragedy / High Death Toll Hook: '[Year] Ka Maha Akal | [Number] Lakh Maut Ka Sach'
